checks.name: Real schema1 catalog migration is additive idempotent and retains teacher bytes and business facts
Current main identity requires exactly one active owner and renderer cannot claim authority
AI Personal publication is private and inactive until the next safe Run without disturbing current resources
New Run captures exact published version and repeated creation is idempotent
Ordinary upgrade and rollback preserve observable old bytes and withdrawn versions cannot be resurrected
Package privacy and executable checks persist only safe failed Drafts and no sensitive input bytes
Required Capability loss blocks publishing while Optional gaps are disclosed without any Grant creation
One Team membership is main-owned and ordinary members cannot approve a pending independent copy
Approved Team copy is independently readable and editing Personal origin leaves its exact files unchanged
Team maintainer edits create a new pending version while members keep the approved version until administrator review
Official publishing requires a persisted trusted main reviewer and stores exact reviewed metadata
Membership withdrawal fences current Team resource reads and cold state preserves history and roles
SQLite CAS rejects stale activation and transaction failure retains the original active version
Failed Draft can be corrected before publication and concurrent names cannot create duplicate Personal identities
Frozen creation rejects getters and actual package hardlinks before source bytes are imported
A pinned source checks the current main actor and rejects a forged cross-owner cold Snapshot
Publication and Team review validate permission declarations without requiring an idle Run Grant
New Run excludes a Skill with withdrawn Required dependency and continues unrelated resources while in-flight reads fence
Exact version corruption fails closed while explicit disabling remains possible
Original Sql callers without transaction retain serialized atomic commit and rollback semantics
Closing a main governance mutation before commit leaves the old active catalog and version facts intact

boundary: Real SQLite, original immutable managed packages and Pi parser. Trusted synthetic main actors. Production Task/Pi/UI tested separately.
